title: A headless worker's session hooks leave no query log distill process in its worktree that makes land refuse it
goal: SP-5x5ut5ko retrospective: the first two headless workers each left five or six querylog.py distill --settle processes running in their worktree (distills of other sessions' transcripts waiting up to USAGE_LOCK_WAIT_S, 600 s, for the distill lock); land refused both branches at step branch until they exited (about 9 minutes). A worker's hooks start such distills outside its worktree, or land tells a distill waiting on the lock from a worker's own process.
